Automatic: the player works out itself when the channel is showing a football match, live or within 15 minutes of kick-off (from its guide, its name or the channels the game is on), and the scoreboard comes on for it by itself. Ask: as before, the scoreboard for the game the programme\'s tile names, else your clubs\' live games. Off: no scoreboard on the picture (Options ⋮ in the player switches it back on).
